purpose: Observable institutional and geographic networks used to compare against project North/West/East/South/Center fields without conflating the two.
boundary: Membership in an empirical network is not evidence of ideological unity and does not automatically assign a project field. These overlays are corroborating relationship structures only.

BRICS.label: BRICS
BRICS.note: Official BRICS describes itself as a Global South political and diplomatic coordination forum; it is not synonymous with project East.

NATO.label: NATO
NATO.note: 32-member collective-defence alliance. Strongly overlaps project North and West but defines neither.

EU.label: European Union
EU.note: 27-member union. Ukraine and Türkiye are candidates, not members.

ARCTIC_COUNCIL.label: Arctic Council
ARCTIC_COUNCIL.note: Eight Arctic states. Provides a real circumpolar layer that cuts across project North, West and East.

NORDIC.label: Nordic cooperation
NORDIC.note: Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden are members; Greenland and Faroe Islands enjoy practically the same representation in Nordic Council of Ministers cooperation.

SCO.label: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
SCO.note: Ten-member Eurasian organisation. A stronger empirical comparator for project East than BRICS alone.

ASEAN.label: ASEAN
ASEAN.note: Eleven-member Southeast Asian organisation after Timor-Leste accession. It crosses the project East/South bridge zone.

APEC.label: APEC
APEC.note: APEC has 21 member economies; this country-polygon view maps the 19 members represented by canonical sovereign-state polygons and records the two special economies separately.

PACIFIC_ISLANDS_FORUM.label: Pacific Islands Forum
PACIFIC_ISLANDS_FORUM.note: 18 members in the official Forum; the Atlas sovereign-country layer maps 14 directly and records four noncanonical/territorial members separately.

SADC.label: SADC
SADC.note: Sixteen-member Southern African Development Community. Strong empirical southern-African comparator without implying that all Africa is project South.

GCC.label: Gulf Cooperation Council
GCC.note: Six Gulf states coordinating across political, economic and social fields. Useful empirical layer inside the project Center/convergence arena.

MERCOSUR.label: MERCOSUR
MERCOSUR.note: Shows a real South American integration layer cutting across the project West/East hinge; Venezuela is currently suspended from its State Party rights and obligations.
